# Cue 1.1.2 — Reliable launcher focus / 主視窗焦點修正
## English
This patch fixes typing staying in Safari after opening Cue from a secure form field.
[Download Cue 1.1.2](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v1.1.2/Cue-1.1.2-universal.dmg) · [Checksums](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v1.1.2/SHA256SUMS.txt)
### Fixes and maintenance
- **The launcher takes keyboard focus directly:** Cue uses a native nonactivating panel, so it can accept input without forcing the source app out of the foreground. Existing field editors keep their caret and input-method composition. No additional permission is needed to open and type in Cue. - **Focus recovery stays bounded:** invoking a visible but unfocused launcher restores focus and preserves its query. Dismissal, Settings, a new invocation, losing key focus, or switching apps cancels stale recovery. There is no polling, keyboard monitoring, or artificial typing delay. - **Less maintenance overhead:** removed temporary focus diagnostics, obsolete application-activation recovery, and unused settings labels/translations. No dependencies were added. Search, ranking, file search, clipboard storage, and command-history input paths are unchanged.
### Install or upgrade
With Cue networking allowed, choose **Check for Updates…**, then **Install and Relaunch**. For a manual install, quit Cue, open the DMG, replace your installed **Cue.app**, and reopen it. Existing settings and history are preserved; use a writable installation location rather than running from the DMG.
For an existing source clone, quit Cue, run `git pull --ff-only` and `./scripts/install-app.sh`, then reopen `~/Applications/Cue.app`. Only **Command Line Tools with Swift 6 or later** are required; full Xcode is optional. See the [source installation guide](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v1.1.2/docs/building.md). Source builds default to Cue-owned networking and automatic checks **off**; official DMGs default to **on**. Explicit saved choices take precedence. Browser search has its own switch.
### Validation and limitations
Optimized tests, isolated feature checks, and serial performance measurements use **Apple silicon / macOS 27 / Xcode 27**, synthetic data, temporary preferences, private pasteboards, and offscreen native views. Review found no change to the core typing/search paths. Measurements cover application search, file ranking, clipboard search, history recall, native editing, and long input; offscreen timing is not physical input-to-display latency. See [performance and validation scope](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v1.1.2/docs/performance.md).
The focus fix was manually verified from a Safari secure login field using the physical hotkey in the optimized beta build. The final source app is also built and checked with standalone **Command Line Tools / Swift 6.4**. Intel and other macOS versions, a full public Sparkle download/install/relaunch cycle, positive real-Spotlight results, live GPT/currency requests, power actions, and fresh macOS permission flows were not re-tested.
Cue is **ad hoc signed, without Apple Developer ID signing or notarization**. Sparkle signatures do not replace Apple's first-launch approval. Follow the [installation guide](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v1.1.2/docs/installation.md) if macOS blocks opening. Window controls and selected-text conversion may need permission granted again for the updated executable.
## 正體中文
這次修正從 Safari 安全輸入欄叫出 Cue 後，文字仍留在 Safari 的問題。
[下載 Cue 1.1.2](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v1.1.2/Cue-1.1.2-universal.dmg) · [校驗碼](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v1.1.2/SHA256SUMS.txt)
### 修正與維護
- **主視窗直接取得鍵盤焦點：**使用 macOS 原生面板，不必強制把來源 App 切出前景，就能在 Cue 輸入。既有輸入編輯器會保留游標與中文組字；叫出 Cue 與打字不需要額外權限。 - **焦點補救有明確上限：**視窗可見但沒有焦點時，再按快速鍵會取回焦點並保留查詢。關閉、進入設定、新的叫出操作、失去鍵盤焦點或切換 App，都會取消過期的補救。不輪詢、不監聽鍵盤，也不加入人工等待。 - **減少維護負擔：**移除暫時的焦點診斷、舊的 App 啟動補救，以及未使用的設定標籤與翻譯。沒有新增相依套件；搜尋、排序、檔案搜尋、剪貼簿儲存及指令歷史的輸入流程維持原樣。
### 安裝或升級
允許 Cue 自行連網後，選**檢查更新⋯**，再依提示**安裝並重新啟動**（**Install and Relaunch**）。手動安裝則先結束 Cue，開啟 DMG，取代已安裝的 **Cue.app** 後重新開啟。既有設定與記錄會保留；請從可寫入的位置執行，不要直接在唯讀 DMG 內更新。
已有原始碼 clone 的話，先結束 Cue，執行 `git pull --ff-only` 與 `./scripts/install-app.sh`，再重新開啟 `~/Applications/Cue.app`。只需要 **Swift 6 以上的 Command Line Tools**，不必安裝完整 Xcode；詳見[原始碼安裝說明](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v1.1.2/docs/building.md)。自行建置版預設關閉 Cue 自行連網與自動檢查更新，正式 DMG 預設開啟；已有明確儲存的選擇會優先沿用。瀏覽器搜尋使用獨立開關。
### 驗證範圍與限制
最佳化測試、隔離功能檢查及依序執行的效能量測使用 **Apple silicon／macOS 27／Xcode 27**，搭配合成資料、暫時設定、私人剪貼簿與離屏原生視窗。Review 確認核心打字與搜尋流程沒有變動；量測涵蓋 App 搜尋、檔案排序、剪貼簿搜尋、歷史回看、原生文字編輯與長輸入。離屏時間不代表實體按鍵到畫面的延遲，詳見[效能與驗證範圍](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v1.1.2/docs/performance.md)。
焦點修正已在最佳化 beta 版，從 Safari 安全登入欄使用實體快捷鍵確認可正常輸入。最終自行建置版也使用獨立 **Command Line Tools／Swift 6.4** 建置與檢查。Intel、其他 macOS 版本、完整公開 Sparkle 下載／安裝／重啟流程、真實 Spotlight 正向結果、GPT／匯率真實請求、電源動作及重新設定 macOS 權限，本輪未重新驗證。
Cue 仍採用 **ad-hoc 簽章，沒有 Apple Developer ID 簽署與公證**。Sparkle 更新簽章不會取代 Apple 的首次開啟核准。若 macOS 阻擋開啟，請依[安裝說明](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v1.1.2/docs/installation.md)操作；更新後，視窗調整與選取文字轉換可能需要重新授權目前版本。
